professionalSummary: Backend engineer with four years of experience on a retail bank’s loan servicing platform, specializing in implementing schedule and interest changes, writing automated tests, managing code review and release processes, supporting operations with data queries, and documenting change limitations and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Implemented 38 schedule and interest changes on the servicing services, each documented on a change ticket.
Wrote automated tests for every change following the team’s test standard, with coverage reports attached.
Managed code review and release approvals, with the platform lead’s approval recorded on each ticket.
Supported the servicing operations team by answering data queries and logging responses, distinguishing direct answers from those requiring lead approval.
Documented limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each change in the ticket closure section.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Three change tickets with test coverage reports, review records, release approvals, and a one‑month query request log, referenced in the ticket system.
